facts.value: Spanish knowledge is strongly recommended for some courses offered in English at University of Talca.

TOEFL score of 87 is required at Fudan University, Tongji University, Jiao Tong University, Nankai University, Xiamen University, Tel Aviv University, Hebrew University, Keio University, University of Kyushu, Nagoya University.

IELTS score of 6.5 is required at Fudan University, Tongji University, Jiao Tong University, Nankai University, Xiamen University, Tel Aviv University, Hebrew University, Keio University, University of Kyushu, Nagoya University.

English B2 proficiency is required at Fudan University, Jiao Tong University, Nankai University, Xiamen University, Tel Aviv University, Hebrew University, Keio University, University of Kyushu, Nagoya University.
TOEFL score of 90 is required at University of Tokyo and Osaka University.
Cambridge English Qualifications 'C1 Advanced' is accepted at University of Tokyo.
GMAT score of 555 (old version GMAT 600) or equivalent GRE is required for QTEM Program.
